newsitem.title: USA: Cordex acquires Austral basin block.
newsitem.headline: Cordex acquires Austral basin block.

text.p: Cordex Petroleums Inc said it acquired a 100 percent working interest in the 190,000 acre, Del Mosquito block (CA-5), located in the Austral basin, southern Argentina, for undisclosed terms.
Cumulative production on the field has totaled 2.2 million barrels of oil and 11 billion cubic feet of natural gas from eight wells since the field was put on production in 1974.

The field is presently producing 160 barrels of oil daily. Proven producing reserves net of royalties are 205,000 barrels of oil and 1.26 billion cubic feet of natural gas. Probable gas cap reserves net of royalties are 3.62 billion cubic feet.

Cordex said its technical evaluation of available geological and geophysical data suggests that low risk, undrilled reserves are present near the field along with other mapped exploration prospects on the block.
The Early Cretaceous Springhill sandstone reservoir is at an average depth of 1300 meters (4300 feet) over the field.
